verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a way for an analyst to see what changed, such as a diff, change history or delta view, when a monitored customer raises a new alert. The closest items are adjacent features: automatic re-screening as lists change, webhooks firing on new alerts or risk-level changes, fetching person risk factors, and cases shown on the customer record. None of these shows the analyst what changed behind the alert, so they earn no credit.
